sentences.en: Then the monkey went round with a little tin cup.
sentences.zh: 然后猴子拿着一个小锡杯四处走。

sentences.en: Bronze-ware is largely made from alloys of brass and tin.
sentences.zh: 青铜器主要由黄铜和锡的合金制成。

sentences.en: My grandma keeps all her cash in a cookie tin.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶把所有的现金都存在一个饼干罐里。
